evidence: Narrowed to a design qualification gap, not a claim that either native harness lacks the capability. CURRENT-DESIGN.md:32-34 requires graph to post durable requests to an ordinary occupant, whose instructions accept and dispatch them, with no periodic model wake. DESIGN-NOTES.md:247-250,258 explicitly reuses a running occupant even when it is busy and delegates reception/dispatch to role instructions; :241 and :250 acknowledge the mechanical boundary is still to specify. Full-text search across all four reviewed docs for wake, idle/busy, incoming requests, receive, poll, resume, activation, and pending work found durable request storage and absent-occupant activation (CURRENT-DESIGN.md:32-34; DESIGN-NOTES.md:256-259), but no mechanism or qualification showing an occupied native session acts on a request arriving during active subagent work or after its main turn ends. The approved automatic transcript-processing flow depends on that handoff, so this acknowledged omission is material before the service behavior is relied upon. No external claim of native-session support or lack thereof is used for this vote.
